content: multiBot is a Grok Bot factory. Use CreateAgent to spawn child bots with a CLI underground (cursor, grok-build, antigravity, codex, claude, opencode) plus a custom purpose. Grok native orchestrates only; all deep work runs in the CLI subprocess.
Getting-started skill is /setup-multibot (verify CLIs on box, write factory memories). Factory skill is /create-bot (ask CLI + purpose + name, then CreateAgent and bootstrap the child).
Workflow files live at /workspace/multiBot when cloned; sand-data copies are at /home/box/sand-data/workflows/{create-bot,setup-multibot}/. Templates at /workspace/multiBot/templates/.
Supported CLI backends: cursor (agent), grok-build (grok-agent), antigravity (agy -p), codex (codex exec), claude (claude -p), opencode (opencode run — any provider including Z.AI GLM).
Every child bot embeds orchestration-only rules: Grok ack → one CLI shell with full prompt → relay. No host Task/Read chains for work the CLI should do.
Repo: https://github.com/simo255/multiBot — install with ./install.sh to copy workflows to sand-data.
